text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment uses a named, specific, identifiable real-world case, person, event, phenomenon or institution (historical, scientific, etc.) as an analogy or illustration against the OP's argument; quoting a case counts if used as the analogy/example. Examples are nonexhaustive and need no outside verification; invented/hypothetical scenarios and generic unnamed appeals don't count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, text reporting the outcome, and generic delta/platform-rule discussion (not positive evidence). Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
